author: badgg
body:
Yeah I retired from Mapdev. Why? Didn't do much as one myself, and I honestly had enough of being in the main staff slack; was getting cringe worthy - was called out for being rude when I just said one statement "I did that too, but lasted longer". Not even the tip of the iceberg.

Staying as an official, now I can focus on one field I am decent at. I will make sure, along with the other officials, that your next tournament is much much much better than the first.
